title: Vowel Counter
description: Write a function named count_vowels that returns how many vowels appear in a string. Treat capital letters the same as lowercase ones.
hints: String iteration checks characters one by one against a vowel collection.
Inspect how you check character membership: uppercase and lowercase characters have different ASCII values.
If your check only looks for 'aeiou', uppercase vowels like 'A' or 'E' will be skipped.
Convert each character to lowercase with .lower() before testing membership, or compare against a set containing both.
Maintain a counter variable that increments whenever a character belongs to the vowel collection, and return it.
